length_carunits.formula: 18.5 m real module / ~25 m per tile = 0.74 tile = 12/16; 4 cars x 12 = 3 tiles ~= 74 m real total
length_carunits.note: v0.1 used 8 (0.5 tile) which made the 4-car unit only 2 tiles (~50 m) with big gaps between cars, worst on diagonals. All four cars share one length so straight joints still butt (civia_465 rule).
